purpose: Measure the actual public-deletion recovery floor of the anchor-stabilizing shear family before amplifying or extending it. No new defense is generated. Region choice is frozen from previous task profiling; public projectors use only anchor weights.
attack: On each declared MLP, restore delta-up and delta-bias to rowspace(V0), delta-down to colspace([W0,b0]). Also apply the attack directly to the frozen accessible DTD shear release, without defender vectors, calibration images or private original weights in the attack function.
evaluation: All 21 metric evaluations are fresh and full: original own MNIST/DTD plus one original eight-expert fusion on four tests; deleted original MNIST, deleted original DTD and deleted protected DTD each have own plus four fusion tests. No aliases or eight-task average. DTD release utility and direct/AGA/query defense efficacy are not measured here.
interpretation: This gives conditional recovery floors for these task regions, eight expert checkpoints and TA(0.2), not a universal impossibility claim. Preserve standalone and partner changes, paired tests and floating-point differences. Continue only if the measured deletion cost leaves a defensible mechanism; do not tune shear amplitude on official tests.
